sut.deploy: kind cluster 'mist', ns trainticket (quick_start base codewisdom/*:1.0.0); FORK ts-admin-route-service:1.0.5 built from the clean a1767ab3 working tree, kind-loaded, swapped in via kubectl set image + set env MIST_FAULT_LOSTWRITE_ENABLED=true for the capture, then RESTORED to base 1.0.0 (flag env removed).

readback.locator: GET /api/v1/adminrouteservice/adminroute [route with the CLIENT-SUPPLIED id present in the returned list; the fork honors client route ids (G2 live proof)]

config.site: AdminRouteServiceImpl.createAndModifyRoute (@Value mist.fault.lostwrite.enabled, Spring relaxed binding; skips the persist POST to ts-route-service)
config.applied_via: kubectl set env on the deployment (process-level, no code path in the request)

negative_control.replay_script: TT-adminroute-control-001 (same stimulus shape, flag off; captured on base 1.0.0 whose persist path is code-identical to the fork with the flag unset - the flag defaults false)

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: With the flag on, createAndModifyRoute returns HTTP 200 {status:1,msg:"create and modify success",data:null} but SKIPS the persist POST to ts-route-service, so the route is never saved. The acknowledgement is a clean success; the write is lost. Norm derivable from the SUT contract (a create that acks success must persist); the absent durable row is presented via read-back: the client-supplied route id does not appear in the GET list.

provenance.notes: LIVE-CAPTURED 2026-07-10 (breadth wave): POST with client-supplied id 7c9d4f7e... acked 200 {1,"create and modify success",null} (the fork's flag-on envelope; data null because nothing was persisted); read-back listed 217 routes, the submitted id ABSENT -> acked-but-lost on a SKIPPED CROSS-SERVICE persist. The ack came from the fork flag-on branch by construction (base/flag-off returns the persisted route object). Breadth role: second write-path service beyond inside-payment; shows the read-back oracle is not cancel/createaccount-specific. AS-DEPLOYED (rev-2.1 R2): the deploy is trace-uninstrumented -> naive_span_error/tracetest_presence/mist_trace_shape = not_applicable. PRE-REGISTERED DESIGN EXPECTATION (not a result; needs a traced capture): under write-path span instrumentation this case is span-presence-VISIBLE - no error span (naive/trace-shape would run and pass clean) but the expected ts-route-service persist span would be ABSENT -> a Tracetest presence-assertion would flag it (a comparator ALSO catches skipped-call lost writes; NOT a clean MIST-unique win, unlike fabricated-ack). ACK-TEXT NOTE: the flag-on ack msg ("create and modify success") is not byte-identical to the flag-off/base persist ack - a cross-leg textual differential tell (disclosed); within-leg the ack is success-shaped-clean (no failure marker). rev-2 migration history: v0.1.0 injection -> fault{}; readback_endpoint -> typed readback.
